setup.command:
corepack pnpm install --prefer-offline && (pg_isready -q -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 || sudo pg_ctlcluster 16 main start) && (sudo -u postgres psql -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='focusarx'" | grep -q 1 || sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE USER focusarx WITH PASSWORD 'focusarx-dev' CREATEDB") && (sudo -u postgres psql -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='focusarx'" | grep -q 1 || sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE DATABASE focusarx OWNER focusarx") && ([ -f .env ] || printf 'DATABASE_URL=postgresql://focusarx:focusarx-dev@127.0.0.1:5432/focusarx
AUTH_SECRET=dev-only-secret-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
ADMIN_PASSWORD=dev-admin-pass
APP_URL=http://localhost:3000
VITE_APP_URL=http://localhost:3000
NODE_ENV=development
' > .env) && set -a && source .env && set +a && corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/db run push && corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/db run seed

run.command: (pg_isready -q -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 || sudo pg_ctlcluster 16 main start); PORT=8080 corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev & PORT=3000 corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/focusarx run dev
